breakdown.description: The prompt assumes equal span implies equal force sharing, but the load split in parallel bars depends on the relative axial stiffnesses AE/L.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly splits the load based on relative axial stiffnesses (k1 and k2), computing F1 = P·k1/(k1+k2) and F2 = P·k2/(k1+k2), rather than splitting equally. This directly fixes the incorrect equal-force assumption from the incomplete prompt.

breakdown.description: The prompt adds the two bar elongations to get the plate displacement, even though parallel bars between rigid plates undergo the same elongation.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly identifies that parallel bars between rigid plates share the same elongation (δ1 = δ2 = δ), and computes a single common elongation δ = P/(k1+k2) = 0.1355 mm. It does not add the two elongations together, correctly resolving the error in the incomplete prompt.
